description: The risk domains the risk_classification flow answers a claim about. Sent as a flow input rather than fixed in the flow config, so a domain added to the catalog reaches the agent with no change on the flow side.

domains.description: Every risk domain in the catalog. The agent answers exactly one true/false claim per entry, keyed by name, and GitLab weights each answer by that domain's severity.

name.description: Key the agent answers its claim under

description.description: What the domain covers, in the reviewer's language
